looks.title: Blackout + one shaft
looks.intent: Black. One thin white shaft stands straight up from behind the press into the roof, the DJ a silhouette cut out of it. Nothing else.

looks.title: Columns from below
looks.intent: The eight column faces glow cold white from their feet and fade to black before the roof; a low white beam at the foot of each far column. The floor is dark, the structure stands up out of it.

looks.title: Haze wall
looks.intent: Haze rolls from behind the DJ; all seven booth beams stand straight up in a row, a wall of light in the haze behind the silhouette; the rest is dark. EFFECT: hazers on (hazer-back, hazer-hall) — NOT SIMULATED.

looks.title: Roof reveal
looks.intent: The space-frame roof appears in pieces: the beams behind the press fan open into the trusswork, then the column beams stand up beside them; a dim white graze along the crane bridge above. Still, no sweep.

looks.title: Slow fan
looks.intent: The column beams lean slowly in across the nave, the wall beams lean slowly out toward the side walls, the booth beams open into a wide fan up into the roof. The move is the slow crossfade in from the reveal (6 s); nothing flashes.

looks.title: Cross beams
looks.intent: Beams from both walls lean in and cross high over the dance floor, above head height, like a lattice in the haze. The booth beams stay upright and dim behind.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red only and low: the columns and the press glow red from their feet, a dim red graze on the crane bridge, the booth beams stand still and dim. The DJ is a dark shape against the red press. The roof stays black.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The whole nave in cold white: every column beam straight up in mirrored pairs, the wall beams up the walls, the crane bridge grazed white from the cut above, a narrow fan behind the DJ, who stands as a silhouette against the lit press.

looks.title: Laser into the roof
looks.intent: OPTIONAL, NOT IN THE LOOP. In the dark, red laser lines from the top of the cut into the roof frame, one dim red shaft behind the DJ. Needs a certified laser safety officer before it is ever switched on. LASER: off by default; requiresLaserSignOff: written at level 0, the laser stays dark until a human raises it after a certified laser safety officer signs off (Class 4, owed).

looks.title: Doors
looks.intent: Before the first act: haze up, the nave columns barely glowing amber from their feet, the press a dim silhouette. Enough to find your way, nothing that performs.

looks.title: The X
looks.intent: The X of PARs on the cut lights the DJ from above while the column beams cross the nave in an X high over the floor — the rig drawing its own sign.

looks.title: Tunnel
looks.intent: The ten column beams lean hard in from both walls and meet in a pointed arch high over the dance floor: a tunnel of white in the haze, the crowd underneath it.

looks.title: Green core
looks.intent: MOXIR's green, once: every nave column glows green from its foot and the press goes green behind the DJ, while a narrow white fan stands up behind the booth. The only colour in the night that is the brand's.

looks.title: Amber dust
looks.intent: The teaser's warm sodium light: amber up the columns and under the crane bridge, low, like dust in a factory afternoon. No beams. A breath between the white sections.

looks.title: Lights up
looks.intent: The end of the night: every column and the crane bridge in warm white at full, all beams off. Clean-out light, not a show look.

looks.title: The blade
looks.intent: The curtain at full white under the cut: in haze a sheet of cold white whose top edge is the cut's 15° slope; the four bridge PARs red at 60 % draw the crane as a frame. Nothing else.

looks.title: The hit
looks.intent: From black: the curtain and the six X PARs at full white together. No strobe channel (rates are untested on the PL5403) — the hit is the cue's own 0 s cut in and out.

looks.title: One shaft on the DJ
looks.intent: Black. The centre curtain PAR alone, full white, straight down on the DJ: one hard shaft from the cut, the DJ in it. Nothing else.

looks.title: White cathedral + the X
looks.intent: White cathedral with the X of PARs on the cut drawn over the DJ.

looks.title: Fan hit
looks.intent: From black, the seven booth beams open in a narrow white fan straight up behind the DJ. No sparks (no chart); the cue cuts in at 0 s.

looks.title: Monolith
looks.intent: The press stands up out of the dark: five PARs graze its faces from its foot in cold white, and far behind it, 50 m deep, one narrow white shaft, the lighthouse. Nothing else. The opening and rest look.

looks.title: Vista
looks.intent: The DJ against a 50 m tunnel: the eight PARs up the columns behind the press in cold white, near pair to far pair, the lighthouse at the end of them, and the centre booth beam backlighting the DJ at 30 %.

looks.title: Light box
looks.intent: The ten column-base beams lean inward at the policy's limit and light the roof lantern from inside as ten parallel planes; the crowd columns glow red at 20 %. The crowd stands under a glowing box; the gap over the DJ stays dark.

looks.title: Forest
looks.intent: Deep red only: the crowd columns and the neighbour-span columns at 60 %, the bridge red. The hall reads endless sideways. Everything else is dark.

looks.title: Crown
looks.intent: The climax, all white: the ten column beams lean into the lantern, the seven booth beams open in a fan behind the DJ, the vista and the lighthouse at full, the press lit. Nothing aims over the crowd.
